**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** June 11, 2025  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Clinical Criteria Met:**

**Diagnosis Requirement:** Met  
Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia (E11.65) documented as active since March 23, 2023.

**Treatment Requirement:** Met  
Patient is currently on insulin therapy: insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime, initiated January 17, 2024, and ongoing.

**Visit Requirement:** Met  
In-person diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. J. Holm on April 6, 2025 (66 days prior to order). Visit note by Dr. R. Castillo documents review of glucose log and HbA1c, assessment of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, and discussion of continuous glucose monitoring.

---

The patient meets all medical necessity criteria for continuous glucose monitoring. Authorization is approved.

Please submit claims with this authorization reference. If you have questions, contact our office.
